_note: Validation vectors. Each vector: feature_matrix (N_cand x N_feat) encoded rows for candidate_solvers, expected_scores (LightGBM raw, lambdarank higher=better), argmax_solver = candidate_solvers[argmax]. C++ parity: build the same matrix, predict, argmax -> argmax_solver; scores should match expected_scores to ~1e-4. Candidates = oracle per-problem set, fallback triple_vocab/per_spec. Models with derived_features (tn_/al_) require computing those columns first.
